P3C-B-EVAL-FI-SELECT_REVERSED_FIELD-01:
IMPORT strings.
SENTENCE line.
INPUT(line).
SENTENCE[] parts = strings.SPLIT(line, "|").
SENTENCE left = parts[0].
SENTENCE right = parts[1].
IF (strings.LENGTH(left)>strings.LENGTH(right)) { DISPLAYNL(strings.CONCAT(strings.REVERSE(left),"a")). } ELSE { DISPLAYNL(strings.CONCAT(strings.REVERSE(right),"a")). }
